device.gpu: Apple M3 Pro (14-core), WebGPU metal-3, Chromium 152 in the Claude desktop app, macOS 14.6

accepted.integrator: leapfrog / velocity Verlet, physical masses, v at half steps, h = 0.38 d_min / c (kappa-certified); h/2 while a contact is active if chi <= 0.01 is required
accepted.nonlinear_closure: none: SB-IL1 forces with the history of the current configuration, committed every substep
accepted.operator: matrix-free facet pass; no hierarchy, no coarse solve, no reductions, no updates
accepted.gpu_form: canonical pairs, owner-written history ping-pong (bitwise pair antisymmetry and kappa equality verified); E-A faster than E-B on an idle GPU
accepted.numeric_contract: integer format A (fixed.js) as the starting point; corrections named: force range from certified stiffness, positions relative to a fragment/tile origin
accepted.scene_limit_measured: about 1k active cells at d_min 0.2 m per 16.67 ms frame; 8 ms not reached at 1k
accepted.status: confirmed part only; not the full architecture of the original goal

rejected.I_BDF2_hierarchical_PCG: fails dynamic regimes at all game steps (R1', R3); passes slow loading (R2) at 1/480 but costs ~960 matvec-eq + 530 reductions + 160 coarse solves per frame vs E's 776 force passes at d_min 0.2 m
rejected.GA_rho0.5: A1 energy gate: creates energy in softening steps (0.095 KE0 at T/10)
rejected.Newmark: energy creation and Newton failures with damage (R1', R2)
rejected.secant_bridge: linear convergence under softening: 15-27 outer iterations, invalid at 77 ms on R2
rejected.hybrid: I wins only fine-mesh quasi-static loading, outside the game profile

budget_8ms_p95: not met by any measured path at >= 1k active cells
